about: Embark on a voyage of discovery and retrace the footsteps of a bygone culture. Solve the mysteries behind dormant devices and learn more about their creators. A diverse and open world full of exciting puzzles and secrets awaits you.
Can you decipher the mechanisms of ancient technologies? Will you uncover the truth about the ones who came before you? Will you find your purpose in this fabled world?
• Explore a stylised and lovingly designed 3D environment
• Solve over 100 tricky logic and combination puzzles
• Interact with machines and globally portable, interactive objects
• Record symbols and pictograms with your scanner
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
